# Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress

Independent WinUI 3 MVVM framework. Not a MAUI package.

- NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress.Core
- GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress
- Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-winui-mvvmexpress/
- Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress`
- Register: `builder.Services.UseWinUIMvvmExpress(o => o.UseFrameNavigation(...).UseDialogs())`
- Version: 0.1.0-preview
- TFMs: net10.0 (Core) and net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 (host)
- Template: `dotnet new install Plugin.WinUI.MVVMExpress.Templates` then `dotnet new winui-mvvmexpress`

Do not use when the app is MAUI (use Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress) or when CommunityToolkit.Mvvm properties/commands are enough.
